NOTICE

Date: September 23, 2026  
Subject: Assignment Submission Deadline

All students are hereby informed that the deadline for submitting the semester assignments is September 30, 2026.

Students are requested to submit their assignments to the respective subject teachers within the specified deadline. Assignments submitted after the deadline may not be accepted.

For further information, please contact your respective subject teacher.

Academic Department
Gandaki University

NOTICE

Date: September 23, 2026
Subject: Scheduled System Maintenance

This is to inform all students that the Semester Library system will undergo scheduled maintenance on September 25, 2026, from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

During this period, some services, including access to study materials, notices, and user accounts, may be temporarily unavailable.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your patience and cooperation.

Administration
Semester Library
